GRAVITY STATION · same 60-cm tube for A and B
15 mL ÷ elapsed seconds = average mL/s for that trial.
A: broad U route. B: broad S route. Keep endpoints, length and bore unchanged.
NTS • Use written dimensions, not pixels or printed scale. Follow the numbered lesson.
